text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $84k with modest gains, while Ethereum is flat, suggesting traders are cautious despite elevated sentiment. The Fear & Greed index at 70 (Greed) indicates optimism, though the slight 7-day decline hints that euphoria may be cooling rather than building. Bitcoin's dominance at 58.8% and $68B in daily volume point to a stable but consolidating market without clear directional conviction.
